text: A woman, likely late teens to early twenties, stands in a cavernous red-lit space. She has pale skin, dark hair pulled back, and an oval face with defined eyes. Wearing a simple white tunic and light pants, she holds a staff or weapon upright. Her posture is alert, facing three cloaked figures. Behind her, another figure sits on a throne-like chair. The cavern walls are textured with red-orange hues and faint carvings.
